standard_prerequisites.name: Renewal theory, homogeneous pinning free energy, Tauberian estimates, basic Fourier analysis and probability inequalities as cited by the authors
standard_prerequisites.use: Standard cited foundations only; all selected local constructions and proof estimates remain in source ranges.

core_obligations: Use the cluster expansion and gap decoupling bound to handle dependence between disorder contacts.
Control the resulting renewal intersection series uniformly as beta tends to zero using Fourier estimates.

proof_roadmap.step: Use the cluster expansion and gap decoupling bound to handle dependence between disorder contacts.
Control the resulting renewal intersection series uniformly as beta tends to zero using Fourier estimates.

difficulty_reason: The seven-step argument retains cluster expansion, dependent decoupling and uniform Fourier control. It is a substantial H2 second-moment result and is not counted again through its later irrelevance corollary.

compared.difference: Old 2687 proves quenched smoothing through entropy and tilting. This proves uniform integrability through a second-moment bound in the alpha<1/2 regime; the final irrelevance theorem is not separately counted.

dedup.scope: Focused same-source lookup in local manifest, preparation worklist and retired claims. Original counted claim and selected continuation claims distinguished; supporting lemmas not separately counted.
